_comment: Style-bonus trigger volumes: axis-aligned boxes in world metres (X east, Y up ASL, Z south). Authored in Stage 4 from the height tiles (tools/flowlines.ts finds the Platteklip gully; tools/track.ts flies the Table line) and checked by flying them. 'gorge' is one volume whose top sits below the gully rims; 'apostles' are three volumes passed in 'order' along the western face above Camps Bay.
